Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

"80 Years End of War – 80 Years of Peace"

May 9, 2025 · Old Town Ochsenfurt

On May 9, 2025, the city of Ochsenfurt organized a commemorative event "80 Years Since the End of the War – 80 Years of Peace," which was framed by Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt "CMI" (director: Dr. Astrid Eitschberger) together with guests from the Italian partner city Bibbiena, Filarmonica Bibbienese "Sereni" (director: Marcello Biagini), the Ukrainian vocal ensemble "FAINO" (director: Viktoriia Hromova), and the French singer Marika Marcuzzi. It was a moving evening for peace and international understanding.
